title: Publication image style profiles: guidelines in data, delivered to every image agent
description: Each publication owns an editor-managed, versioned visual style profile held as backend data (a third doctrine kind beside mission and policies): prose guidance plus structured fields, example and negative images, binding constraints such as the Machines on Machines ban on generated photorealistic imagery, and a per-site image review setting. The shared image service resolves it, snapshots it on every candidate and delivers it into the context of every agent that generates images. Style lives entirely in data; only a minimal skeleton prompt is hard-coded. Design: project/wiki/image-toolchain.md (sections 5 and 6). Build order PRs 2 and 3.
